map.为什么加摩擦角 ρ？: Why add the friction angle ρ?
map.螺纹升角 λ 与摩擦角 ρ 合成等效升角，自锁条件 λ≤ρ（即效率≤50%）。: The helix angle λ and the friction angle ρ combine into an equivalent helix angle; the self-locking condition is λ ≤ ρ, that is efficiency ≤ 50%.
map.导程角越大效率越高？: Does a larger lead angle raise efficiency?
map.是，但过大失去自锁（如千斤顶需自锁选小导程角单头螺纹）。: Yes, but too large loses self-locking. A jack needs self-locking, so choose a small lead angle and a single-start thread.
